member.name: SileroWorker
member.para: What pre-binding bought. Measured with tools\vadbench on 2026-07-31: pre-binding plus the single-threaded session options took the shipped per-frame cost from 116 to 95 us, bit-identically.
What a shared session cost. Same measurement date: 802x realtime at 4 workers, 360x at 24 - it stopped scaling past four and then got slower with each one added.
